feature_name: Release Version Bump and Changelog Update
description: Prepare the codebase for a new release by updating the version number across configuration and package files, and documenting recent changes in the changelog. This ensures proper version tracking and release documentation for version 1.14.4.
functional_requirements: Update the version number to 1.14.4 in the project configuration file
Update the version number to 1.14.4 in the main package initialization file
Update dependency lock file to reflect the new version
Add a new section to the changelog for version 1.14.4 documenting fixes from specific pull requests
